name: Zur Eiche
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy beer and garden pub with a covered outdoor area, 27 beer varieties and BBQ evenings in Innsbruck.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Gastgarten zur Eiche is located at Innstraße 85 in Innsbruck's Sankt Nikolaus district, just a few steps from the Inn. Stepping into the rather unassuming establishment from the outside, a spacious, green garden pub opens up with string lights and a relaxed atmosphere. The covered outdoor area offers around 65 seats, complemented by outdoor lounges and about 50 indoor seats that are open all year round. According to the establishment, the drinks menu features 27 different beer varieties, various aperitifs, and a wine selection from its own wine cellar. The Tirol tourism source describes the place as a large garden pub with plenty of greenery, BBQ evenings and live music in a casual atmosphere with a regulars' vibe.

History/Background

There is no reliable, publicly documented information about the establishment's history. The official website and the tourism sources describe the Gastgarten zur Eiche as a classic beer garden with a modern, relaxed bar culture. In restaurant directories the establishment is listed as an inn and categorized under Austrian or German cuisine. Today the focus is on good beer, aperitifs and convivial gatherings amid greenery.

Getting there

The address is Innstraße 85, 6020 Innsbruck. The garden pub is located in the Sankt Nikolaus area, east of Innsbruck's old town on the Inn. Public parking spaces are available in the surrounding area; the Congress garage is about 312 meters away. A public transport stop (Tsm Reisedienst) is about 768 meters from the venue. The establishment is wheelchair accessible and offers free Wi-Fi for guests.

Tips

According to the website, opening hours are Tuesday to Saturday from 17:00; in the months from April to July, it opens on Tuesdays and Fridays already from 15:00. On Monday and Sunday the establishment is open by reservation only. On Wednesdays there is a student day from 18:00 to 20:00 with discounted beer and spritz wine. Antipasti are available on pre-order and should be ordered at least one day in advance. For celebrations such as weddings, birthdays, company parties or graduation parties, custom menus are put together on request.

Best time to visit

As a garden pub, the establishment is especially an experience in the warm season, when the outdoor area with string lights and lounge furniture can be used. Thanks to the covered outdoor area and the roughly 50 indoor seats, the evening can be enjoyed all year round. Anyone wanting to take advantage of the extended opening hours in spring should plan a visit between April and July on a Tuesday or Friday.
